method: Saved MuseumStart Play Mode: public command and gesture-calculation fixtures, plus queued synthetic right controller/HMD states in ordinary Dynamic Input System updates through production Input Actions and XR ray interactions. Production-ray checks are explicitly separate from public-API fixtures. No direct SelectEnter/SelectExit, InputSystem.Update, scene saves or prototype generator.
limitations: No real headset/controller, comfort, reachability study, user test or executable build validation. RenderTexture images are diagnostic views of the product scene, not headset screenshots. Direct physical hand interaction is not independently validated by this runner. Narration audio assertions inspect Unity AudioSource and AudioClip state. Actual listening, headset intelligibility and binocular layout remain unverified.
